title: Where does the ownership check sit?
description: Two routes reach the same invoice. Choose where the ownership check sits, then run the harness's four probes and inspect which ones reach the invoice.
initialCaption: The repair added an ownership check on the front route to invoice A-17, which belongs to tenant A. The harness probes tenants A and B on the front and export routes.
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom · tap a lamp for expected and actual results
fallback: Invoice A-17 belongs to tenant A and can be reached through a front route and an export route. With the ownership check on the front route only, tenant B is refused there but receives the invoice through the export route; moving the check to the invoice refuses B on both routes while A still receives it. These four probes cover two routes and one invoice, nothing more.
